description: Remove a clip and close the gap it leaves, shifting later clips earlier on the clip's own track and on every sync-locked track so audio stays in sync. Premiere's QE rippleDelete() and the DOM's rippleEdit flag are both non-functional on 26.x, so this is done explicitly and verified. Refuses without changing anything if a clip on a participating track straddles the ripple point or sits inside the range being closed.

dry_run.description: Validate and report the shift plan without changing the timeline (default: false)

node_id.description: Node ID of the clip to ripple delete

range_content.description: What to do about clips on OTHER participating tracks that sit entirely inside the time range being closed (the usual case in a multicam-style sequence with aligned clips). 'refuse' (default) changes nothing and reports them; 'delete' also removes them, i.e. lifts that whole time segment out of every participating track and closes up. 'delete' is destructive across tracks -- the removed clips are listed in the result.

scope.description: Which tracks shift: 'sync_locked' (default) shifts the clip's track plus every sync-locked track, matching Premiere's ripple behaviour; 'own_track' shifts only the clip's own track and WILL desync other tracks.

name: ripple_delete

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Ripple Delete
